_comment: Bots and apps that open issues or PRs, and the source label each one's work carries (design 6.8). Logins without '[bot]'. issue_fields.py flags an issue a bot opened with no source label; bot_pr_review.py (issue-sweep) adds a listed bot's label to its PRs and puts a 'no_issue' bot's PRs on the board. 'no_issue' bots open PRs with no issue behind them (dependency updates, release-please's Release PR), so pr_closes_issue.py lets their PRs through without `Closes #n`; their label says where they came from. Peras's PRs close their intent, so it is not 'no_issue'. 'renovate': a Renovate, Mend's (renovate) or the one platform runs in its own workflow (akenon-studio-renovate, design 6.4); the two are treated alike. 'status_pages': titles of issues a bot opens as its own status page, not work (Renovate's dashboard and config-error issue, design 6.8): the issue checks skip them without starting a job (issue-fields.yml's job condition repeats them), and scripts/automation_failures.py reads them. Every label here is in rulesets/labels.json. 'org_apps': the org's other apps, which act (merge, close) but open no work, so they carry no source label: with the sources, the only bots the automation acts for in a public repo (rules.acts_for, design 6.2).
